t: Get 20 Fish Bones and hear a prediction about the coming hunt from the Spinner Family.

Wait, wait. We heard that you're are going hunting. If that case, you need a prediction... We are the Thread Keepers who see the future... Do you know that all that exists is woven together, ?

If you want to know if the signs are favorable today, or if knots and patterns promise you evil, we will need to perform a reading. For the weather, for fate, for everything to turn out right...

Words are like yarn. They can also be woven into a pattern which is called a verse. This is enough for now, even though it's better to see the canvas that's being woven in Skalgard... But puzzling out the meanings is a long work, and here we can do it faster.

I need fish bones to put a verse together. They come out of the waters they share with Lyngbakr, so they will tell me what I need...
I'll need half for fortune-telling, and the other half for soup...

Of course, we are not Seida who could have woven everything into patterns, but nevertheless...

We don’t know what Lyngbakr will do, but the hunt will be successful - we are certain of it!
Collect 12 Fish Bones and take them to the Spinner Family.

We heard how the Spinners predicted a successful hunt for Lyngbakr for you! Well, it's the right way - better than searching for meanings in the Carpet of Fate. Now that Kharyskhan has been expelled from Isa, we need to know what else is coming. What will happen to the Urun, whether Frost will spare us, and what to do about the darkness...

All in all, we shouldn't pass up an opportunity to peer into the future! Collect the bones. Let's see what the sea has to say this time. Then give them to the Spinners.
I'll need half for fortune-telling, and the other half for soup...

Excellent! Bones are exactly what we need. We'll try to arrange them into verses again and see what the sea says...

Run along now. This prediction might not be about you, so you don't need to hear it! When we need you, we'll send for you.

You're new here, so let's repeat the lesson!

No nets can be made this week. And watch your gear so it doesn't get tangled. Now is such a fateful time. Every knot you tie affects your path in the world.

Therefore, only us Spinners are allowed to spin and weave today.

All right, go now! Your eyes tell us you understood everything.
Help Galli Hook get to the fire in the village.

H-h-help! H-help m-me!

Please help me s-swim to shore! Can b-barely move my p-paws, and my t-teeth are chattering!

Nearly froze to death! Th-th-thank you! Br-r-r...

When you s-see my b-brother, tell him that e-everything is in ord-der! But I'm not going b-back today...
Go to sea on a ship.

Everything's ready! All aboard!

So, , are you coming with us? We don't have extra seats on the ship. Hunting is sacred business, it's not for outsiders.

...Oh, abyss take you. Fine, fine! Get on board.

But you'd better do as I say and don't be a coward! The sea loves those strong in spirit!

Well, we are at sea! Ruff take it, how I love this stuff!

The weather is favorable, the only thing left to do is to lure this big fish... and then catch it!

But don't think it's that simple, ... Before we're finally ready, we need to do a few important things... Yes, yes, nothing big can be done without preparation!
Smear Bear Grease all over yourself and kill 12 Morays in the sea.

Alright.

There is another problem. We have Morays here. Terribly ferocious. And hungry. If we throw the bait into the sea now, they will immediately devour it, and there'll be nothing left for Lyngbakr.

There's no time to waste. We must do it now, before the monster returns to the bottom again.

Do you have Bear Grease, ? Excellent. Smear it all over yourself and dive. The fewer Morays are around, the more blood in the sea and no competition for bait.

And keep your wits about you so the fish doesn't gobble you up. We might not get you out in time.
The salty sea will become even saltier with blood! The hunt is close!
Smear Bear Grease all over yourself and kill 8 Ice Morays in the sea, then report back to Styr Ruff.

Uh... We have a task for you. We keep thinking about ways to protect the Tree from all sorts of enemies on the Winter Watch. The thing is, some enemies are hidden - we don't see them, so they don't seem to pose a direct threat! But they can easily cause trouble...

The three of us talked and decided that the morays are a threat! Since there is no Lyngbakr, there will be no one to eat them, and they will breed freely and eventually become a problem for the fishermen. Without the sea, there would be no supplies for the defenders. So we need to reduce the number of morays.
Ho-ho-ho, youngster! The Sharps are right, there are more and more morays around here, and we should reduce their number when we can - otherwise there will be no other fish in the Empty Sea!
Find the Rune of Luck among the sunken ships on the seabed.

Hey, , listen up! Since Ruff has decided to throw you into the sea, help me with something, will you?

There was once a fisherman named Hummi, and one thing separated him from the others - he was very lucky. His friends and brothers thought that maybe it was his fate or, as the Heidruns said, he'd been born under a lucky star... except the prey went into his net on its own, and he constantly pulled out the biggest fish with his fishing rod.

But the thing is, I know he had an amulet - a rune of great luck! But then one day... Trouble came, and luck turned away from him. Hummi's boat sank, and the rune disappeared...

Whether you believe it or not, it would be nice to find it. Such an amulet would be very useful to us now! I think it's somewhere at the bottom, in the wreckage... Try to get it!
Oh, if Jon had this rune...

Do you think it's the one, ? You don't know? Neither do I!  I have never seen it in my life, only heard stories.

Well, let's find out. If I never miss, then it’s definitely the one!

Oh, I feel uneasy... Last time everything ended badly! Dammit. Oh...

I hope this time everyone makes it home in one piece.

But this is a dangerous business, . When we see Lyngbakr, there'll be no time to think!

We'll have to act without thinking.

What should I do? I will tell you. The team is waiting for my order, and when you're ready, just say it!

Never heard of a fish flying over the abyss! Some kind of sorcery...

Well, ruff take it!

Here it is, my dream fish! Lyngbakr! Huge Lyngbakr!

Well, it's big enough to feed not just the clan, but the whole of Isa! And I'll nail his head onto my house.

Oh, fate brought us together for a reason, ...

So what did you want to get out of his belly?
Search Lyngbakr's entrails and find Gerda's amulet among other garbage.

Flying fish, just think about it! It's a pity I wasn't there! , you will tell me everything in detail, right? Right?

Let's look for my amulet! It's made of blue gems.

How about you look for the amulet, and I'll tell you if you find it. Because looking at his entrails makes me feel queasy...

Flying ships?! Are you serious? That means…

! We urgently need to go to Skalgard!
Go to Skalgard with Gerda on Ratatoskr.

, I need to tell Uncle Broddie everything! And the spinners! And everyone else! And…

Oh, who is that...?

Ohhh! There you are!

I took a second shift today just to catch your arrival. It was worth it! My sister will be so jealous!

My name is Akke, by the way. In case anyone asks. You know, for a heroic saga in your honor. Say it was Akke who let you into Skalgard.

We have a lot fun here! I'll tell you all about it.

Oh, right. Welcome, !

, I see you've helped a lot of people in the city, which tells me you can be trusted...

But Isa's main dangers lie outside Skalgard's walls. And I'm afraid the news is disturbing. Messengers from the Winter Watch have recently arrived. The Urun are spotted more and more often, which means they need help. I don't have enough people here. Every warrior counts! And they can't handle it without me...

So I would like to ask you for help. I will go to them, and I suggest that you and your friends meet me in the Snowy Forest at one of our outposts. Prepare well before this trip!

Oh, and remember: the forest is a cold place. If you don't want to freeze, you need to drink mead.

Excellent! You're here, , I knew I could count on you. My brothers are watching over Skalgard, and your help will be appreciated here... You will also learn what the Winter Watch really is.

First of all, we should strengthen our defenses and prepare for a possible Urun raid!

Hey Orc, how are you? !Aho! Is that what you say? Aho, !Hey, furless one! Is your name ? Have you ever seen snow?Hey, furless one! Is your name ? Have you ever seen snow?Hey, furless one! Is your name ? Have you ever seen snow?Hey, furless one! Is your name ? Have you ever seen snow?Hey, stone guygal! Is your name ? Have you ever seen snow?Hey, fellow Gibberlings! !

No weapons can help us if we all freeze here! Remember that a true Gibberling is not one who never gets cold, but one who dresses warmly! Our own skin is good, but a second one doesn't hurt, so we need an extra supply of pelts. After curing them, we'll have excellent fur coats.

Fortunately, the local lynxes and foxes have great hides - they stay warm even in the fiercest winds. If you want to help, get us some pelts.
Hunting is hard work! But I think you can do it...

I think I heard a raven! Good omen...

Yes, I see you're a pretty good hunterhuntress, ! So many pelts, and most are undamaged. You must have done this for years! Broddie was right, your help will be much appreciated!
Obtain 7 Lynx Pelts and 7 Fox Pelts, and then report back to Sigi the Skier

Wow, Frost is not letting up! And we hoped that with Kharyskhan gone, he would calm down a little, but no - he is still just as fierce. So, you need to find a way to fight the cold.

Well, let's light bigger fires and hand out the mead. Perhaps the best remedy is better heat insulation.

We need fur coats, to put it simply. Therefore, we need to go into the forest and hunt game there. I decided to entrust this job to you, too. After all, you're a decent hunterress, so you'll get us excellent pelts in no time. Go on now!
Hunting is hard work! But I think you can do it...
Great, this will do! The animals keep coming from the east anyway - Frost is even angrier over there, so there will be too many of them here! Well, this is good for us.

Orc, get over here!Priden! Do you hear me?Hey, furless giant! Listen up!Hey, furless giant! Listen up!Hey, furless giant! Listen up!Hey, furless giant! Listen up!Hey, stone giant! Pay attention!So, guests from another island! Brothers and sisters!

The Urun are not the only trouble in the forest today! Kharyskhan's awakening stirred up the Treant guardians... And now they are trying to drive everyone out - even us! Evil fir trees - who could have thought! Now you have to carefully move through the forest to avoid getting killed by a fir branch...

Of course, we are not going anywhere! Alas, you will have to deal with the guardians of the forest - they will be reborn in other trees anyway, so there is only one way out - kill them, .

But be careful. They are extremely strong and they barely feel pain - after all, they have resin, not blood.
It's hard to walk through the forest when there are these crazy fir trees...

Wow! You're quick, ! I see you're covered in needles and resin, so I'm guessing you're done with the Treants...

I'm sorry for them! But what can we do? We can't explain it to them anyway, they're too stubborn. Let's defeat the Urun - and the Treants will return again.
Kill 3 Fir Treants and report back to Olaf Mush

Here's what we think: the Urun are currently not a threat to the Winter Watch - they are defeated, and their remnants have retreated behind the ridge. However, there are those in the forest who will not back down... the Treants!

Or rather, our Yol trees, guardians of the new year. Well, you've seen them.

I thought they'd mellow out with time, but no! They are still raging. All you can do is run away screaming.

Froddy, the elder from the Frozen Frontier, says the shadow woods are to blame. It seems like the All-Mother's power imbued with Darkness drives the trees crazy... But at least they stopped withering!

And if we don't want the Yol trees to take our outposts apart, we must subdue them! Alas, there is no other way out.
It's hard to walk through the forest when there are these crazy fir trees...

Oh, thank you! Previously, they were much friendlier, we even decorated them for Yol for children! Someone dressed up as Num, gave them gifts... And now they can't be approached - they've become hostile... It's all Frost's fault!

I know you Orcs are fond of the bottle... right?! Admit it! Hehe.Here on Isa we had to figure out a lot of things. You have no idea!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!They say you have your own sages... But ours aren't bad either!

We have something to surprise those ugly cats with!

Especially if you remember the mead… Hehe. Over the centuries, our meadmakers have learned all sorts of interesting recipes... Explosive mead, for example! You just need to drop a barrel, and the consequences will be most impressive. Enough to scare those savages out of their wits!

But we have one problem - these barrels are very heavy, and there is no one to carry them. Maybe you can do it, ? Just bring them to the three marked spots, and from there they can be dropped on the attacking Urun!
Yes, the barrels are heavy, but what can we do?!

Excellent! That's how it's done - we don't attack in a crowd like savages, but prepare in advance...

We have all sorts of secrets here. Maybe in time you will see other unusual things!
Move three explosive barrels to the catapults and report to Njall Potts.

Oh-oh-oh! The Elder asked us to bring these heavy barrels with mead, but our lower backs hurt something terrible... Yes, all three of us are in pain! On top of that, Wickham's left leg hurts, and Trondur's right arm is useless. There's no way we can carry them - we'll die!

Can you help us? All you need to do is carry three barrels to the catapults! Plus it's a good exercise! Right? Right?!

Exactly! Thank you very much. In the meantime, we’ll think about other threats to the Winter Watch!
Yes, the barrels are heavy, but what can we do?!
And the Elder told me the Sharps were supposed to deliver them! Did they rope you into this?! Damn, those rascals! Anyway, what do I care? Just get the catapults ready.

Look what the wind blew in! White hides, fangs and claws are all over the forest! They also brought Sabertooths with them.

And look! There is also a Jotunn! How did they get him to come here?

Eh, I would love to join in, throw a few punches. But I can’t - I'm on guard duty!

Oh, bother... But I think we can fight them back... with your help, . There is also your friend Murk who wants to prove that he has nothing in common with these distant relatives of his.I bet you want that, too. So go ahead. Kill those Sabertooths and the Urun together!

And don't let the Jotunn crush you! He is terribly fierce and won't be easy to take down, so let’s try to come up with something.
There are many enemies, but you two can handle it!

Glorious battle!

I heard everything from here! Yes, you and Murk make quite a pair, ! Oh, you dealt with them so quickly! I wish I could join you!

Even their teeth didn't help them! We'll have to ask our guys to collect the fangs afterwards - we'll make amulets from them...
Kill 7 Uruns and 7 Sabertooths, then report back to Broddie Stalwart.

After we drove the Urun and their pets out of Skalgard, many of them fled into the forest. And they are still there, hiding among the trees! We need to kick them out of there, otherwise you never know... what they will do next.

Which is why I want you to deal with them! We need to rid these lands of the Urun and the Sabertooths. Let them cower in the frosty valleys behind the mountain ridge.
There are many enemies, but you can handle it!
Alright! I'm sure there are some remnants lurking around, but the more we beat them back, the fewer of them will remain. That's the kind of math I like! Sooner or later there won't be any left!

And one more thing, !

I see you have already been introduced to our explosive mead... But this is mostly just to scare enemies. We have another very secret recipe - a special drink that turns you into a real hurricane! Brewing it is not easy, but it's worth it.

It must be distributed to our warriors who are fighting in the forest... Let them fight! Rip enemies apart with teeth and hands!
With our mead we can definitely defeat the Urun!

As you can see, mead is really quite useful! Without it, things would be much more difficult for us! Now you can just drink some, and then a whole crowd can't stop you! I've done that myself many times! With brothers, of course.
Distribute 7 cups of Fire Mead to the members of the Winter Watch and report to Broddie Stalwart.

Ah! Today, the Threads told me this: our fighters, brave warriors, are still fighting the remnants of the Urun army in the forest! We need to help them, otherwise it's going to be bad... Thanks to you, we have a remedy - the same magic mead that makes them stronger. So you need to hurry - take the mead to them before it's too late. With the mead, they will defeat everyone - the Threads are right about that...
With our mead we can definitely defeat the Urun!
Yes, our warriors just ran out of mead! You've arrived just in time. Otherwise there would've been trouble! But with mead, we can now overcome everything!

Now the most important thing - the Jotunn! You can't take him down with your bare hands! What to we do?

Let's use our catapults and explosive mead!

You just need to land a hit... The target is big, but it won't be easy... Unless... Can you lure him to the fire, ?

Your task is simple - draw the Jotunn's attention and lead him there. You can do that, I hope? We just need to bring him down, the rest will be easy.

Have you fought off the attack, ?

It's a pity that Kharyskhan left... What an insolent creature! He's relentless... My ancestors fought him, and the ancestors of my ancestors... Yes, we remember him well, he caused a lot of suffering among the Gibberlings!
Find the missing caravan with mead.

Everything is going well so far. We're fighting off the enemy. Of course, it would be much worse without your support, . The guys are inspired and ready to fight. Smash and crush, crush and smash!

One thing worries me - the mead. You can see it yourself - we can't get anything done without our mead. And the next delivery is delayed... why?

We need to find out what happened... But as luck would have it, there's no one to send there but you.

See if you can learn anything... I have a bad feeling.
Oh, how terrible... We're so unfortunate...
Meet with Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker’s Tower

The letter reads as follows:

"So, !

I know you and Yasker are at odds, but the matter is too important to be left unresolved.

This witch Hirkalla now holds us all in an iron fist, but while we are slaving for her, the world is falling apart. And I'm not joking. You'll see for yourself.

Anyway, we need to talk. I'm not leaving Yasker's Study, so we'll meet here.

Come see me before it's too late."

Judging by the letter, Wrokag's matter will bear no delay. Why did the Supreme Shaman of the Orcs decide to write to you?

Although you haven't been to Yasker's Tower in a while, you should answer the old Orc's call.
Phew, I was thinking of sending the City Council after you...
Meet Froddy the Fidget at Aidenus' Tower.

The letter reads as follows:

", my dear friend!

It pains me to hear that you and Aidenus are at odds, and our Great Mage does not want to see you again. However, the matter that prompted me to write this letter is too important to take such quarrels into account.

The Goddess of Darkness Hirkalla who now rules our world closely watches everything we do - she will not allow anyone or anything to disrupt her control. And yet the world is falling apart, and I mean that in the most literal sense.

I suggest we meet. Since I am now constantly in Aidenus' Tower in Novograd, I think we will find each other here.

Please hurry, I beg you."

Judging by the letter, Froddy's matter is urgent. Why did the Gibberling Elder decided to write to you?

Although you haven't been to Aidenus' Tower in a while, you should answer the wise Gibberlings's call.
Oh, why is it taking so long?
It’s good that you're here. I was about to start looking for you.

Oh, this is terrible...

That accursed Jotunn... crushed the last barrel of fire mead!

Damnation! It was the last one, we can’t get more of it. We had enough for the coming harsh winter.

And what now? Frosts get worse almost every hour! If the Uruns decide to attack under the cover of this blizzard, our Gibberling friends will all freeze and won't be able to fight back.

I don't know what to do! Can you help us somehow...?

You need to go to the Mead Valley... the warmest place on this island where we Heidruns dwell... Maybe the Elder of the Meadmakers can come up with something?

Ah, there you are, ...

I swear on my mug, if what Waterlily told you is even partially true, then we're saved... Or at least there's hope.

Let me describe the situation for you - it was our last mead, and the flowers in the valley have already withered - the bees have nothing to collect. And we still have problems with these fire dogs, damn them!

We have no barrels, no ingredients... And even if we had them, brewing mead is not that easy! You don't think we brew it here everyday just for fun, do you?

But if you're such a hero, then you will solve these problems easily, am I right? Am I right?!

, the Elder told me this island has alternating seasons - there are times when flowers sprout, grow, bloom and then drop new seeds into the ground.

It looks a lot like Eden.

And if you need these flowers to wake up ahead of time, then I can help you by talking to them. There is nothing to be surprised about. You can talk to both flowers and trees.

The All-Mother said that every garden needs a gardener to look after it. If we need to awaken dormant flowers to achieve our goal, then so be it. I will take on this responsibility.

As you can see, everything is simple. They agree to bloom ahead of time, live a shorter time and fall asleep again.

This is their sacrifice and their gift. To all of us, !
Eliminate the Fiery Wolves that are a threat to the bees, then bring the bees to their senses.

Withering flowers are not our only problem!

See for yourself,  - the valley is full of Fiery Wolves, spawn of Muspel! The keeper of the volcano Surt Junior used to keep an eye on them, but he disappeared some time ago!

The wolves have swarmed the valley and the smoke from their fire puts the bees to sleep!

I beg you - drive the wolves away and bring the bees to their senses!
Poor bees... I feel sorry for them!

Excellent! Even if we have flowers but no bees, the result is the same - no honey!

One thing is unclear - where did the guardian of the volcano go anyway? Does he not care about his pets? It's very strange.
Bring 10 bees to life and report to Yonko

Today, a curious pattern has emerged, a dead bee... We wondered what it meant - and then we figured it out! This is the Mead Valley - the smoke of the volcano is probably affecting the bees again, sending them to sleep...

You need to bring the bees to life again, or else they will die! It's time for them to hibernate.
Poor bees... I feel sorry for them!
Poor bees, they always get into trouble! Thank you for bringing them to life!
Eliminate 10 Fiery Wolves and report to Yonko.

Hmm, I've received news from the Meadmakers!

In short, the Fiery Wolves are roaming close to the village again. Apparently, the winds of Frost are driving them away from the volcano, and they do not understand what is happening.

But we don't want the Meadmakers to die in a fire, do we? So we need to act. Knock some sense into the wolves. Don't worry: they'll be reborn again - they are spirits, not living creatures.
A wolf is a wolf. I mean, wolf eats wolf! Oh, never mind! I've had enough of the wolves.
The wolves are becoming bolder! I should talk to Surt - he needs to control his pets! Or they'll burn everything down!

Our bees are not some stupid bugs with a sting - our bees are really clever. It took us a long time to breed the kind that would exist peacefully here, in a valley surrounded by ice... In exchange for their help, we feed them and look after them.

Many Heidruns got injured or fled in fear after the Urun attack, so there are barely any bee shepherds left. So I ask you to take on this job, .

I will give you a special pipe that lures bees. Carefully watch the swarm, it's important that not a single bee gets lost.
You have to look carefully so not a single bee gets lost!

All the bees are safe and sound? Excellent! Losing even one would be a tragedy!

Thank you for your help, ! Now we are waiting for my sister - she must bring the secret ingredient for fire mead!
Drink mead and defeat the Jotunns.

Fire mead! What do you even knowdo you even knowdo you even knowdo you even knowdo you even knowdo you even knowdo you even knowdo you even know about mead,OrcPridenbare-skinned outlanderbare-skinned outlanderbare-skinned outlanderbare-skinned outlanderbare-skinned outlanderstrange family? Mead is... serious... business... Hic...

Yes, I… I b-beat up all the Jotunns… after a... c-cup of mead! Just three s-sips are en-nough! Just three!

Wha-at? You d-don't believe...? Me-e? Yes... I… I’m not in a... fit state… right now... I'm tired… Maybe you can t-try? D-drink mead! You will scatter Jotunns like kittens! T-trust me! D-drink mea-a-ad!
What? You don't believe me? I won't lie… Mead is power! And power is mead! Let's drink!
Under the effect of special Mead, kill 3 Jotunns, then report back to Tura Mugg.

Wow, we've remembered something! Jotunns! Huge, vicious giants! They are the most dangerous creatures on Isa. Although… Well, Jotunns are definitely the biggest!

They live beyond the mountains and come down here sometimes. They love the Mead Valley, because it's warm there...

But we need to drive them away, otherwise you never know... Even one Jotunn can do so much damage...

Mead will help you defeat them. The Meadmakers always brag about it - how they drank the mead and then pummeled all the Jotunns. We reckon you can do that, too. You can tell them your story later.
Didn't I say m-mead is power? I once met Ymir himself, and w-we fought... and f-fought... and fought some m-more... I w-won.
Cut down trees for the barrel.

Now we have enough mead, but no barrels! To brew mead, you need a new barrel, because this stupid Jotunn broke the old one into pieces...

We need special wood... Usually, our lumberjacks mark suitable trees. It will be great if you go there and cut them down, and then my assistants will take them away to make planks!

After the Urun attacks, we don't have enough hands, so you'll need to roll up your sleeves and work for a bit! Don't delay, !
You have to watch out for the trees! Don't let one fall on you!

Have you cut down the trees? I'll ask you to bring them here - anyone can handle it. Though not everyone can swing an axe and avoid being crushed by a fallen tree! It's good that you're pretty smart, !

I see we're running you ragged? I'm sorry about this welcome, times are hard right now... It'd been a while since the Urun attacked us, so we weren't prepared.

Now we are waiting for our messenger who went to get the secret ingredient... And you should take a break! Isa is not just cold winds - it's also hot springs filled with the warmth of Muspel.
.
, take a dip in the spring, and your fatigue will go away!

Your friends can use the spring, too! They are run by my young sisters - Mayane and Yarune.
It's nice, right? For all the things you've done, , we allow you to use the springs at any time! Remember that here, in the Mead Valley, you will always receive a warm welcome.
Rest in the hot spring for 2 minutes, then report to Tabeko.

Yes, Winter Watch is not easy! And now the Gibberlings from all allods are coming here - every great warrior - hoping to prove themselves. Such competition is unnerving! So we need to perform as many feats as possible so they don't consider us weaklings... And you will help us with this!

Oh, we just realized we're running you off your legs! To the hot spring, then! Let's relax!
It's nice to see you here again! Mayane and Yarune have missed you so much! Come back again!

Greetings, ! I am Yabko's sister Yalane, the messenger who was supposed to find Surt Junior and get his secret ingredient for the mead… What is it? Oh no, it's the Greatest Secret of the Meadmakers! Secret!

The thing is, I couldn't get to the keeper! There were terrible sounds coming from his dwelling in the lava fissure, and I was afraid to go inside... I think Surt might be in danger!

I've heard about your exploits, so maybe you can help? We'll be indebted to you.

Ah, bastards! Servants of the accursed Frost and vile cats! They are in cahoots! Yes... it would be really bad without you...

And who are you, anyway? An Orc? I haven't seen one in a long time!Another cat? But black?! Priden?It's the first time I see someone like you. What are you?It's the first time I see someone like you. What are you?It's the first time I see someone like you. What are you?It's the first time I see someone like you. What are you?It's the first time I see someone like you. What are you?Another noisy Gibberling family? What brings you here?
Talk to Surt and get the secret ingredient from him.

Did the Heidruns andother Gibberlings send you here? Were they afraid to come? Hmm...

Yes, heroes are not the same these days... In the old days, they came by themselves, but now... That's what quiet times mean. But if the Urun are here, then Kharyskhan has awakened again...

Where are you from? Hmm...

From outside lands? Hmm... Is there really a lot of land left? The Great Mages preserved it? I heard of them, but it was a long, long time ago...

Did it work? I didn't really believe that Surt would give us another one!

The keeper has done you a great honor, . Even here few people know about the secret ingredient.

Now you are one of the chosen ones!
Brew mead in the Meadmakers' village.

! For your great help, I will give you an incredible honor - I will allow you to assist us in brewing fire mead! Not every Gibberling is worthy of it, so be thankful!

I hope you don't mess up and let me down... Make sure to listen to me very carefully!

The recipe calls for many ingredients mixed in the right order at the right time.

Well? Shall we start brewing?

It is done.

Here, have a mug of the fresh mead, ! It will also come in handy if you decide to go to the far north! Without it, a terrible death awaits you there!
Well, as my grandfather - Hazen the White was his name - used to say: Let's brew already!
Meet with Unn and discuss what is happening to the Great Trees.

, I wonder what's going on?

Some nonsense is going on. Suddenly everything went wrong. The spirits of Igsh are worried. I'd even say they are terrified. And the reason for everything is in the Dead Sea. Maybe you remember that a sprout of the Great Tree was planted in The Rusty Anchor?

It's the one in trouble. To be honest, I'm not really good with trees. I know more about animals and spirits but, fortunately, there is someone who can help us. There is still peace with the League, so a whole Gibberling delegation has arrived there. After all, they also have their own Tree, so maybe they will figure out what's wrong. They also brought someone from Eden with them just in case...

So I'm sure you'll solve the problem together.
Do not disturb the thoughts of one who gazes into the distance with their mind.

Yes, the Great Trees are linked to each other. And to the All-Mother who gave birth to them...

However, everywhere I went, I felt the onset of decline. The Trees have become too weak, the connection between them too fragile. We won't achieve our goals here, or on the Kanian Archipelago, or New Isa... Let alone Eden, which is so far away...

But there is one more Great Tree we have yet to visit.

I don't know which side you were on and what you fought for. But this is no longer important - we all suffered from the actions of these deities of Darkness. That is why I am here in your world. Perhaps this is where we can deal with the Darkness.

But now grief has seized all the worlds. The All-Mother is the source of our strength, the strength of Life itself and Creation. Without her, existence is doomed... The Great Trees begin to weaken and die. There is a sense of decline even in Eden.

You fought bravely for us, and I can't blame you for anything. It was the All-Mother's choice to go to Sarnaut, which means it was fated to happen. The Children remember your sacrifices and will always come to the rescue. That is why I am here in your world. Perhaps this is where we can deal with the Darkness.

But now grief has seized all the worlds. The All-Mother is the source of our strength, the strength of Life itself and Creation. Without her, existence is doomed... The Great Trees begin to weaken and die. There is a sense of decline even in Eden.
h: Ask Waterlily what is going on

t:
Well, I remember your choice and that you fought against us. However, while my kin demand vengeance, I do not share their views. Perhaps, despite whatever divides us, we all need to find a compromise. That is why I am here in your world. Perhaps this is where we can deal with the Darkness.

But now grief has seized all the worlds. The All-Mother is the source of our strength, the strength of Life itself and Creation. Without her, existence is doomed... The Great Trees begin to weaken and die. There is a sense of decline even in Eden.

, a misfortune has befallen us...

You know that Frozen Frontier is now our new home. Under the patronage of the Great Dragon Nordrak, we are building a New Isa to replace the old, lost one.

However, it's not easy to break the glaciers and free the dragon! The sprout of the Great Tree we received in Darkwater aids us in this.

With its help, we will turn New Isa into a blooming garden sooner or later.

At least that's what all Gibberlings thought until recently. Now... alas, the sprout is not doing well. And we still don't really understand why.

The seer Unn, whom you already know, has arrived. She went straight to Darkwater, to their Great Tree. She has Waterlily with her - your friend from Eden. But they need you, too, I'm sure. I really hope you will figure out what's going on...

t: Go to Howlem and talk to Murk

The Great Tree of Howlem is the oldest known to me. If it doesn't help us, nothing else will.

The Pridens are not happy to see uninvited guests here, so I asked your old friend to help us. We are talking about Murk, of course...

How do we get there? No, we don't need a ship. Know that mystics have a great secret, . The magic of the Astral is very powerful, and there is a secret spell of transportation that only the strongest mind knows.

When you're ready, tell me so, and I'll take you all with me to Howlem.
Yes, this is Howlem, the home world of the Pridens.

Aho, !

You won't be pleased by this news.

Howlem's Tree is dying faster than the others. And our allod has already begun to crumble. If this is not stopped, soon the Pridens will lose their homeland.
So be it. Now be quiet and stop thinking!
h: We are ready to go to Howlem

t: Go to Howlem and talk to Murk

The Great Tree of Howlem is the oldest known to me. If it doesn't help us, nothing else will.

The Pridens are not happy to see uninvited guests here, so I asked your old friend to help us. We are talking about Murk, of course...

How do we get there? No, we don't need a ship. Know that mystics have a great secret, . The magic of the Astral is very powerful, and there is a secret spell of transportation that only the strongest mind knows.

When you're ready, tell me so, and I'll take you all with me to Howlem.
Yes, this is Howlem, the home world of the Pridens.

Aho, !

You won't be pleased by this news.

Howlem's Tree is dying faster than the others. And our allod has already begun to crumble. If this is not stopped, soon the Pridens will lose their homeland.
Obtain spirit particles and fill the Spirits of the First with power.

The one you call Murk is right.

Only our faithful friends and patrons - the Spirits of the First, those four that remained on Howlem - still hold the ever-growing rift with their powers. But their strength is running out...

I believe I know how to help them. Particles of the power of the First, once stored in the seed of the Great Tree, are now released from the fractured earth. They have been absorbed by various animals in our Sanctuary.

If you help collect them and deliver them to each of the four spirits on different sides of the rift, they will be able to stop the destruction at least for a while!
Hurry! The First are getting weaker!
The power will help the Spirits of the First! But it will delay the destruction only for a while. If we don't find a solution, a great calamity will befall us.
Meet with Unn in the temple.

I don't know what else would help. If I knew, I would have done it myself, but... I am powerless here, eysh!

There is still hope - the wise Unn is trying to find a way to send a message through the Great Tree.

I know it won't be easy, and who knows what sacrifices you'll have to make. But Howlem's fate is at stake, and each of us will gladly give their life so our homeland lives.

Now is not the time to cling to old customs.

Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.Since you came with a misfortune we all share, now you are as much a member of our family as any of the Pridens.You too are a Priden, and the years spent outside Howlem don't change that. And your friends are now members of our family like any other Priden.

Therefore, the Sanctuary is open to you.

Let's try and do something.
If that doesn't help us, nothing will.

Ahh... ahh...

Zvik, zvik! I was sleeping...

Who are you and what's going on?

It's amazing to see the ancient power of the Pridens. Once upon a time, when the world was whole, our peoples were great. They formed an alliance against the Orcs in order to expel them from Isa. Before us is the legacy of those times.

You are a child of the Orc people. But we don't hold it against you. You are far from the deeds of your ancestors, and the Horde is long gone from this world.The Gibberlings have a vague memory of what happened. Only fragments of legends remain from those times, but it is good that the Pridens also keep that memory. I hope you keep it, too.We Gibberlings owe it to the Pridens. Remember this, my little brethren. They are now on our side, like in the old times.Although you do not share the history that connected the Pridens, Gibberlings, and Orcs, you should remember it and draw a lesson from it.Although you do not share the history that connected the Pridens, Gibberlings, and Orcs, you should remember it and draw a lesson from it.Although you do not share the history that connected the Pridens, Gibberlings, and Orcs, you should remember it and draw a lesson from it.Although you do not share the history that connected the Pridens, Gibberlings, and Orcs, you should remember it and draw a lesson from it.Although you do not share the history that connected the Pridens, Gibberlings, and Orcs, you should remember it and draw a lesson from it.
Ask Ratatoskr if she knows what's happening to the Great Trees.

I understand that I am on Howlem, so our plan must have worked. Howlem exists in the middle of the boundless ocean of the Great Nothing! And the Priden people are still alive. So the sacrifice of the First was not in vain!

Yes, and the Howlem's Tree, the offspring of the Great Ash Tree, is still standing… Although I feel that something is wrong… Is that why you woke me up?
A squirrel! It's alive! I was able to reach it!

, I can't believe my ears.

The Gibberlings were sure that Isa was long lost. But if one of the First is certain that Isa exists...

We have to get there!

Yes, I understand that terrible sacrifices will have to be made, but there is no other choice. If Isa and the Great Ash exist, we must find them no matter what! And Ratatoskr is the only one who can help us.
How long was I asleep? Interesting... Zvik, zvik.
I feel sorry for the old raven... But Ash's fate is more important than our fates.

Isa had its own wise men and its own secrets.

There is one very old spell - Vegvisir! It will take you home, wherever you are! And my home is Isa and the Great Ash Tree, on the branches of which I live.

Alas, it's not so simple. To use Vegvisir, we need a lot of power. I don't have it now.

But if you know how to get it... Then let's hurry, Ash needs our help!
Isa could not die - the Ash Tree is its reliable support!

Apparently, Ratatoskr the Squirrel's plan succeeded and Vegvisir really transported you... to Isa?

The homeland of the Gibberlings that is believed to have been destroyed?

How did it survive and why have the Gibberlings never found it? All these thoughts flash through your mind as you feel a terrible cold that penetrates to the very bones.

Do you feel like you haven't achieved everything you set out to on Isa? Not ready for further exploits? I know how to help you. We Gibberlings have many enemies on Isa. You will find them everywhere. Fight them, and you will quickly achieve perfection. Come back here after defeating fifty enemies, and I will give you a small reward.
The more enemies you defeat, the stronger you become!

Well, we're glad the Urun are finished! They are finished, right? We think we won't see Kharyskhan on Isa again. And the rest of the problems are easy to overcome. Yes, and there'll be way more people here. Look how many have arrived...
h: What are your thoughts on what happened?

t:
There you are!

We don't know what you did there with this Kharyskhan, but as soon as he disappeared, the Urun lost all their fighting spirit. They all froze as one, ears pressed to the head, hissing!

We drove them away from the city then! Along with their tame cats and bears. It will be a while before they stick their noses out of their caves again.
Talk to Gerda about the hermits and visit Styr Ruff in the Fishermen's clan

, the most severe punishment on Isa is being banished into the mountains, beyond the bear's ridge. If a Gibberling can survive out there alone, they will most certainly be re-educated. And then they can be forgiven.

But if an exile's Thread breaks, all that remains of them is an empty stone in his clan's eternal boat. Just like my great-great...

This is so sad, . Did they do something that got them exiled for good? Even in our Carpet of Fate, their threads disappeared completely without a trace - I tried looking for them...

Hm...

Hmmm...

I have an idea!

We'll go ourselves and find out!

I'm terribly afraid of sailing, but I have no choice!

Where do you want to go? To the Bear Land?

I didn’t think you could surprise me again after Lyngbakr, sea cadet!

Oh, my beauty! My darling!

I'm talking about the boat, don't get any ideas now!
Get to the Bear Land on Styr Ruff's boat.

Oh, the Bear Land? Why do you want to go there? Aren't you afraid to die?

Okay, so be it! I'll take you all. I’ll take you there, but then you'll be on your own. Don't be mad, but my team is not ready to climb mountains yet!

Remember - in those parts Frost's breath is stronger than here. Don't even think about going there without mead - you'll freeze right away.

Well, that's it, sea cadet! My boat has never gone this far. You can get back on another boat - the water won't freeze for a while here.

Luck be with you!
Follow the mysterious hermit through the blizzard.

Brrr! It's so damn cold here! And the wind!

I hope you've stocked up on Fire Mead, , otherwise we'll all turn to ice here...

Let's move faster! I think there is someone in the blizzard!
[The hermit looks at you demandingly and points her paw at the bear.]

Those who are no longer needed by their people!

Yor faithfully served old Beorn, but he betrayed our tribe. The white cats returned, and Beorn sold his people to them in exchange for promises...

This is a false path. Yor challenged the leader, as custom dictates. Yor fought for the truth but lost. Beorn laughed at Yor when he threw him off a cliff before he could die in battle.

Yor can no longer hunt. Yor would have been food for white cats if little Lyrra had not brought you.

Speak, outlander. How can Yor repay his debt?

Vain search, outlander.

The hermits of the Ash Tree quickly perish in these lands, and their traces are forever buried by a blizzard. The age of the bear is not great enough to remember that far back.
h: We're looking for traces of a hermit who lived here two centuries ago.

t: Bring Blood Moss, Yak Meat, and a Barrel of Mead to the hermit Lyrra from her hideout.

[The hermit persistently points her paw at the nearby red moss and grazing Yaks, and then pokes in the direction of the bear. He was wounded by huge claws and teeth. He needs medicine and food. And something else that looks like… a barrel?]
[Lyrra angrily waves her paws. You'd better hurry!]
[The hermit silently begins to stuff the bear's wounds with moss. He gradually comes to his senses.]

Rrr!

Yor would have torn you into a hundred pieces had little Lyrra not stopped him. Now Yor is grateful to you. But Yor is too weak to stand up and fight for you.

How can he repay you?
A couple of scratches won't bring Yor down!

Only one of us is old enough to have seen those times.

Now I see that fate itself did not allow Yor to kill him...
Eliminate the Urun and the Rebel Werebears, and defeat Beorn.

Beorn… His fur has long since become white - not from birth, but from gray hair. The old leader lived three lives of a bear.

He won't talk to you unless you show him your strength. Go and finish what Yor started.

Those indoctrinated by Beorn will stand in your way. White cats are among them. They will come to your land. Very soon.

Don't let your hand falter, outlander.

Even if only snow remains on the cliff after you.
Kharyskhan did not lie when he promised Beorn immortality... Now I see!
Eliminate 6 Urun and 6 Werebears, then report back to Yor.

I have another task for you. You see, the Urun have been spotted not just in the forest, but also on the Bear Ridge. They seem to have joined forces with the Werebears lead by Beorn who is almost immortal now.

 We need to break this alliance somehow! I think if you hit the Werebears regularly, they'll realize that their friendship with the Urun is too much trouble. And drive them off the mountains. So - prove to the Werebears that they need a new leader. Maybe that Yor that you told me about.
The mountain paths are still full of Urun!
Our people are stubborn and persistent. They will be loyal to Beorn until it finally dawns on them that it won't end well.
Use the Frost Absorber to absorb 3 Frost Spirits, then report back to Yor.

Do you know who is our main enemy on Isa? No, not the Urun and not the Werebears. Our main enemy is Frost and his servants. Technically, they are not alive, since they don't have hot blood. All they want is to freeze the entire world. Imagine what it would look like - seas frozen to the bottom, icy mountains instead of green lands.

We must stop him somehow. We have an artifact from our great-grandmother here - the Frost Absorber! We will give it to you, and you will go to the Bear Ridge and try to absorb the power of the Frost Spirits! Fewer spirits - less frost!

Tell that Werebear... Yor! Let him see if it gets warmer.
Are you done with the task?
Great! The fewer Frost Spirits, the better! But make no mistake, little friends. They will come back...
Gather 12 portions of Blood Moss and take them to Lyrra.

We got another prediction. Little exile Lyrra. For some reason, her Thread is important to the Pattern. Why? Only Fate knows.

However, we see that Lyrra is in trouble. She needs help. Bear Ridge is a dangerous place. If she is out of supplies, death will come quickly. Frost is trying to kill Lyrra, but if you save her, it will be a great boon. Get some Blood Moss for her and Yor.
[Lyrra angrily waves her paws. You'd better hurry!]
[The hermit silently begins to stuff the bear's wounds with moss. It looks like they can survive another week.]
Ask the Werebear about the hermits of the past.

Look what the wind blew in...

Well, ask your questions... And then get out! I'd rather not see you again...

So annoying...

That bear hun-hurr lied to us!

I swear on my tail, if there had been any passage here, it must have been filled up a long time ago...
Walk the Hermit Trail along the Bear Ridge.

Wow, what a mean Werebear! He's helping Kharyskhan! And he lied to us!

But what can we do? ! We'll go the other way! If this is a dead end, we just need to find another way. Through the mountains!

Even though the mountains get higher and steeper, we will make it!

, have you seen this?!

I can swim now!!
Find out what the cave is hiding.

, I feel like we're getting VERY close!

But we must be very, very careful. Here you can run into dangerous creatures. And even an Isfrun!

It would be nice to warm up.

Whoa!

In our family, the story of the Freya and Captain Koll was retold many times, but no one ever believed he could have reached Isa!

Only... it looks like he was shipwrecked. What happened to the crew?
Put to rest the Zverg spirits

Eysh! They said the miners had died two hundred years ago, but you can still hear the music of their hammers here!

Haven't they found peace yet? That's not good, shoysh!

, I suggest we put an end to their earthly existence. Even though they are ghosts, I believe they are still suffering. We also need to make sure they don't attack us all at once!

For two hundred years we have guarded the heavenly wanderer. Waiting for the blood to resume its course.

Now we are free.

The blue stone will reveal the last secret to you.
Learn the history of the ship.

, so all this time we had a huge flying ship right under our noses?

And nobody, nobody knows about it?

And nobody, nobody remembers it?

Wow, I have so many questions!

, just think about it!

If Koll had returned from Isa, and our ancestors had learned the way to their homeland, everything would be completely different now!

The Gibberlings wouldn't have joined the League, the world wouldn't have learned the secret of the meteorite, there would be no astral ships! Or at least it wouldn't have happened so soon.

And so many little brothers and sisters wouldn't have been lost in search of our lost homeland... They had no idea the Threads themselves diverted their path away from Isa.

We would have a home... A true home!

Damn...
Fight Kharyskhan and save the Gibberlings.

I'm so proud of my great-grandfather Koll! He acted so wisely and courageously, just like Wald from my favorite saga!

It's a pity the spinners had to break the weaving of his fate. Had it been otherwise, I could have brothers or sisters now. And I would never be this lonely... Like Mom was, and Granny...

But that's okay! What's important is the fact that he protected Isa and saved the whole world from the evil Orc spirit. I don't regret anything.

Oh…

 Oh-oh-oh!

, there's Urun over there! A whole pack!
The Threads must have decided so! If you were destined to learn this, it was meant to be. The call of legends has led you to the Freya... Is this really the end of this story?
Rescue Murk from the fighting pit.

In short, we caught a black Urun - I don’t know where he came from - and threw him into the pit so he would fight the Whites! Sounds like fun, right?

Although… you look the same… maybe we shouldn't have?Hmm, I see by the look on your face that something is wrong…Hmm, I see by the look on your faces that something is wrong…Hmm, I see by the look on your face that something is wrong…Hmm, I see by the look on your face that something is wrong…Hmm, I see by the look on your face that something is wrong…Hmm, your reaction tells me that something is wrong…Hmm, I see by the look on your face that something is wrong...

He's your friend, you say? A Priden? One of those who once fought with us against the Orcs? Oh, bother... But he fought bravely, so he might still be alive? I suggest you hurry, otherwise anything can happen!

Just remember that it wasn't out of malice - we just had no idea that the Pridens returned!
We need to see the Spinners! Only they will help. Who are they? Have you never heard of the Thread Keepers? Yes, that's exactly what they are!

Anyway! ! Listen to me. I don't like repeating myself. When I'm asked again, I usually give people a kick to jog their memory!

Since ancient times, in every large Gibberling village, there is a special house with a sacred loom in it. The Thread Keepers weave the great canvas on it - the Fabric of the World, and thereby determine the Patterns of Fate and try to direct the Threads of the Gibberling Path in a way that they form the most favorable pattern for us.

It is they who know what was, what is, and what will be! I'm afraid that an evil that has been imprisoned for a very long time has awakened... and now we need to defeat it...

Ah, there you are...

We've been waiting for you for a long time, yes. We saw your Thread in our canvas. Black as night itself. Yes, yes, , we're talking about you... Stormbringer. They didn't name you that for nothing. No, no, be quiet about the Urun, don't say a word. We know everything, we've seen everything...

Fools! You have awakened the ancient curse of Isa!
Learn the history of the curse.

The Orcs... Our ancient enemies. But this enmity has long decayed, or so we thought. Do you believe that? I hope so.I hope the Pridens still remember our ancient alliance... Once upon a time we fought shoulder to shoulder and found a common destiny. And now it brought us together again.Foreign nations. We have stories about you. We now share the fate of our world with you.Foreign nations. We have stories about you. We now share the fate of our world with you.Foreign nations. We have stories about you. We now share the fate of our world with you.Foreign nations. We have stories about you. We now share the fate of our world with you.Foreign nations. We have stories about you. We now share the fate of our world with you.Lost and forgotten relatives. Oh, I see that your path to your home was hard. But the evil you brought is now your fate, too.

You already know that our entire history is a weave of Threads. At the right time, the great loom weaves a fabric, and each thread is someone's Fate. We, the Thread Keepers, have knowledge that is passed down from teacher to student through the ages. This knowledge allows us to interpret what we see - to the best of our understanding, of course. Fates create a shared history…

, let us show you how what you've done is related to the fate of all Isa…

When the Ash Tree weakened, our island began to crumble little by little! The cave where Kharyskhan was imprisoned split open, and the spirit's prison appeared on the surface. And you finished the job with your own hands - you broke the ice prison and released the spirit! Just imagine how much trouble he can cause!

We understand why you came to Isa... But can we help you now? That's not the case, I'm afraid. If Kharyskhan appears again, war cannot be avoided! The Urun, led by him, are a threat both to Skalgard and to other villages! And even to the Ash Tree - for it has always been his target! And if you don’t get to the Ash Tree, then you won’t be able to do anything!

So first, deal with him, and then we'll talk about what can be done.
Are you aware of the succession of generations whose destinies are woven together in a single canvas?
Collect the threads of Snow Spiders.

We have a tradition here. Everyone is supposed to be connected into a single whole, right? The Thread Keepers will explain it better. But tradition is tradition, so you should do it, too It means you need to help weave the carpet. Where do you think Threads come from?

The easiest way is the web of Snow Spiders. So you'll help us in two ways - you'll get rid of the spiders and obtain threads so you can intertwine your fate with ours. Smashing spiders is always a plus! I even envy you.

Yes, , the Spinners asked you to visit them first... They want to talk to you about something.
Yes, the web of Snow Spiders is exactly what we need!

Excellent!

We can't do without signs and predictions!

In Skalgard, no one would step out of the house if they spilled salt at breakfast. And if someone puts an empty bottle on the table, we immediately punch them in the eye!

However, , they also say that if Fate is favorable, then you can take on any challenge, even if it's hard!
Obtain 12 rolls of Snow Web Yarn and take them to Finny the Eagle-Eyed.

, there's another job for you! The Frosty Woods are crawling with spiders lately! Your task is to go and reduce their population. They scare our guests, weave webs between the trees on the roads - then you have them stuck to your face! And collect more of their threads while you're at it, then take them to Finny the Eagle-Eyed. Threads are essential - besides the Carpet of Fate, we also make tackle and clothing with them.
You don't remember the task? Kill the spiders and collect yarn
Wow! Thanks, ! These spiders are damn scary. And thank you for the silk, too - I will pass it along!
Collect cones for the squirrel Iora.

The Thread Keepers themselves sent you? Wow! I always wonder how they see these things in the Threads.

I have a request for you, of course! Do you see my squirrel? Cute, isn't she?

She is still small, and I'm afraid to let her out of my sight. There are spiders everywhere, and the squirrel is hungry. If you bring me some cones, I will be extremely grateful!
Oh, thank you! I'm on patrol, and my squirrel is starving! Without your help, we would be lost!
Collect 12 cones and take them to Finny the Eagle-Eyed.

Sometimes predictions are incomprehensible to us, but over time a lot becomes clear... So, now the Threads are telling us that Finny the Eagle-Eyed is important for the future of Skalgard, and his squirrel will play an equally significant role.

I don’t know what will happen, but we must not turn away from the signs. Let's do as the Threads tell us!

Your task is to feed the squirrel. It might seem a trifling matter - but it could be no less important than your victory over Kharyskhan!

Get some firewood and throw it into the braziers. Then report to the Sharp Family. It's their idea.

Here's what you need to do...

Well, ? Do you accept the challenge or not? After all, we'll be fighting together later, so we need to know what you're worth!

From the glorious warriors of our clan we formed a hird - a Gibberling detachment. Members of any clan can join it, and if circumstances require - all the Gibberlings of Isa.

Many are disturbed by the invasion of the Uruns, and fear overcomes them.

I wondered if it could be helped - and it seems that I have found a way. There is one belief - if a cone suddenly falls on one's head, they will not be afraid of anything.

I will let you see whose Thread is trembling. You will throw a cone at them, and even though it might startle them, they will stop being scared afterwards.
Signs will help us! The wisdom of the ancestors is infinite.
I no longer hear the rustle of trembling Threads, which means our idea was a success! Still, ancient signs are great knowledge. We may not understand them, but there is considerable wisdom in them.

Wow! We defended Skalgard from the Urun so heroically! But after the victory, our warriors relaxed! We need to shake them up a bit so they stay vigilant.

And then we remembered the cones. I think they will definitely help! Throw a cone at the residents, it'll be good for them! Even if they swear at you! Ignore that - they don't mean it!
Signs will help us! The wisdom of the ancestors is infinite.

Here's what you need to do - ask the local blacksmiths if anyone has seen such metal. After all, if they did see it, it means that a meteorite was once mined on Isa...
